title: Davinci Spolvero feed
description: The observer's folio output as one consumable document (P2-18): the pages a run emitted, in emission order, under the schema_version Spolvero negotiates on (devtool.md data layer - a consumer refuses a mismatch loudly instead of misrendering). Producers: `davinci-opt --folio-dir` writes it as `spolvero.json` beside the pages (SpolveroFeed::of_dump over the same FolioDump, so directory and feed cannot disagree; a page's file name derives as `{seq:03}-{stage}.{pass}.folio` from its array index and fields), the inspector payload embeds it under `spolvero`, and the wasm `analyzeSfc` result carries the full S1 -> S2 -> S3 stage ladder next to the croquis alias. Transport is deliberately unspecified here - that decision is P2-19.

schema_version.description: Feed format version. Incompatible shape changes bump this.

path.description: Source file the page was produced for, when the producing surface works per-file (the inspector); null for a single-artifact pipeline run.

stage.description: Stage (or stage page family) that produced the page: the ladder emits `s1`, `s2`, `s2-provenance`, `s3`, `s3-partition` and `s3-values`; `davinci-opt` pages use the dumped stage (`croquis`, `budget-observer`, ...).

pass.description: Producing step: the pass name for a pipeline dump, or the non-pass step that made the page (`parse` for the S1 surface tree).

text.description: The page text: canonical Full-mode folio text, or for S1 the byte-faithful surface render.
